# OpenMath.jl

> A Julia implementation of the OpenMath 2.0 standard: an object
> model for the semantics of mathematical objects, and readers and
> writers for the official encodings.

## Documentation

- [OpenMath.jl](https://s-celles.github.io/OpenMath.jl/)
- [Object model](https://s-celles.github.io/OpenMath.jl/object-model/)
- [Validation and normalisation](https://s-celles.github.io/OpenMath.jl/passes/)
- [Security](https://s-celles.github.io/OpenMath.jl/security/)
- [Decision D1 — the XML backend](https://s-celles.github.io/OpenMath.jl/design/xml-backend/)
- [Decision D3 — the JSON backend](https://s-celles.github.io/OpenMath.jl/design/json-backend/)
- [API reference](https://s-celles.github.io/OpenMath.jl/api/)
